# eJukebox Website - Copilot Instructions

## Typography Rules

- **Never use em dashes (—) or en dashes (–).** Always use a regular hyphen/dash (-) instead. This applies to all content across the entire site: markdown files, HTML templates, SCSS, and any other text content.
  - Wrong: `It Costs More — Here's Why`
  - Right: `It Costs More - Here's Why`

## General

- This is a Jekyll site hosted on GitHub Pages (branch: `gh-pages`).
- All pricing figures should be sourced from official OneMusic PDF guides and rounded to whole dollars in display text (e.g. $471 not $470.98) unless shown in a data table where exact figures are used.
- Currency is Australian Dollars (AUD). Always include the `$` sign.
